notes: The 48-hour ultimatum now plays out on its own in well under a minute instead of needing the speed cranked up, with a live countdown in the top bar. The clock also ticks during the build-up.
Before the war, every deployment lands in Kuwait straight away: transit times only apply once the war starts.
The Kuwait camps grow with the build-up, so every brigade you order can stage there instead of being refused for lack of room.
On G-Day every combat brigade staged without an area of operations is given one and crosses with the rest of the force; aviation brigades follow into the AOs.
A brigade's own medical and intelligence companies now move with it into its support area and FOBs instead of waiting in Kuwait for a camp.
